universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid professional medical teal/emerald palette.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or rounded buttons with smooth hover transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure .js/.jsx files are structured cleanly with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
